product_media_location_present.name: product_media_location_present
product_media_location_present.value: "product_media"."storage_key" is not null or "product_media"."source_url" is not null

carts_owner_present.name: carts_owner_present
carts_owner_present.value: "carts"."user_id" is not null or "carts"."anonymous_key" is not null

orders_delivery_window_order.name: orders_delivery_window_order
orders_delivery_window_order.value:
"orders"."expected_delivery_start" is null
        or "orders"."expected_delivery_end" is null
        or "orders"."expected_delivery_end" >= "orders"."expected_delivery_start"

coupons_discount_present.name: coupons_discount_present
coupons_discount_present.value: ("coupons"."discount_bps" is not null) <> ("coupons"."discount_toman" is not null)

users_identifier_present.name: users_identifier_present
users_identifier_present.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone_e164" is not null

trips_departure_window_order.name: trips_departure_window_order
trips_departure_window_order.value:
"trips"."departure_window_start" is null
        or "trips"."departure_window_end" is null
        or "trips"."departure_window_end" >= "trips"."departure_window_start"

trips_arrival_window_order.name: trips_arrival_window_order
trips_arrival_window_order.value:
"trips"."arrival_window_start" is null
        or "trips"."arrival_window_end" is null
        or "trips"."arrival_window_end" >= "trips"."arrival_window_start"

publication_jobs_target_present.name: publication_jobs_target_present
publication_jobs_target_present.value: "publication_jobs"."product_id" is not null or "publication_jobs"."content_entry_id" is not null

pricing_rules_price_band_order.name: pricing_rules_price_band_order
pricing_rules_price_band_order.value: "pricing_rules"."price_band_min_eur_cents" is null or "pricing_rules"."price_band_max_eur_cents" is null or "pricing_rules"."price_band_max_eur_cents" > "pricing_rules"."price_band_min_eur_cents"

pricing_rules_scope_target.name: pricing_rules_scope_target
pricing_rules_scope_target.value:
("pricing_rules"."scope" <> 'CATEGORY' or "pricing_rules"."category_id" is not null)
        and ("pricing_rules"."scope" <> 'BRAND' or "pricing_rules"."brand_id" is not null)
        and ("pricing_rules"."scope" <> 'PRODUCT' or "pricing_rules"."product_id" is not null)
        and ("pricing_rules"."scope" <> 'TRUST_TIER' or "pricing_rules"."trust_tier" is not null)
        and ("pricing_rules"."scope" <> 'PRICE_BAND' or "pricing_rules"."price_band_min_eur_cents" is not null or "pricing_rules"."price_band_max_eur_cents" is not null)
